title: Reconcile version-aware before/after updates
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. A version is an explicit ordered revision of an order, not its arrival time. db_before holds three orders; db_incoming includes a stale version, a newer version and a new key. The policy accepts only a strictly greater version, preserves untouched orders and never deletes without a deletion contract. Equal-version replay must keep one row per order. All timestamps are the same fixed UTC boundary: choosing by timestamp cannot solve this exercise. db_expected_after independently specifies the required final key/version/amount/updated_at. Reconcile it to db_after; count missing/unexpected or differing joined rows plus duplicated order_id groups. Purpose: detect stale overwrite, duplicate replay and unintended deletion. This is final-state version reconciliation, distinct from ADF arrival batches and timestamp watermarks. RUN/REPLAY applies the actual local version guard; it cannot recover an already lost newer value without Reset.
learning_objectives: Justify conclusions using independent keys, exact values and observable evidence.
